notes.title: BIG update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've just released an update with these changes:

* Added tutorial 
* Added tutorial to minigames
* UI changes
* VFX update to better visualization of objectives
* Bug fix on Hologram
* Bug fix on level select
* Bug fix on gameplay

We've made the changes thanks to your suggestions and feedback. They are very welcome.
